description.value: Nostos Taverna is a family-run Greek restaurant on West Broadway in Kitsilano, founded by a family with deep roots in the Aegean island of Evia. The menu rotates seasonally around traditional dishes—rack of lamb, imported-feta Greek salad, and artisan dip platters—alongside a small cocktail list. The name draws on the ancient Greek concept of 'nostos,' a homecoming from a long journey, which gives the place a particular resonance for cycle tourists arriving hungry from the road.
